claims.claim: Serializer ships as the NuGet package Truvio.Commerce.Serializer, installed at or above the layers' floor
Platform floor: the package installs on Dynamicweb 10.17.5 or newer
Config at Files/System/Serializer/Serializer.config.json; without it Deserialize fails
GET SerializerSettings validates the staged config; a rejected config fails every call
Predicate mode Replace or Merge; legacy Deploy and Seed are rejected
Four routes: Serialize, Deserialize, PackageDownload, PackageUnzip
Inline Scope may only narrow a configured predicate of the same mode
A scoped serialize folds into the mode manifest and does not clean stale entries
YAML ownership header per document; Deserialize honours it per document
Deprecated aliases SerializerSerialize, SerializerDeserialize, SerializeSubtree removed in 1.0.0

excluded.reason: Migration note about removed route names; no function on engines at or above the floor.

claims.claim: Deserialize body must carry Mode; an empty body runs a live Replace; query mode overrides a body Replace
Dry-run content counts under-report; gate on failed == 0 and the entry count
Deserialize is driven by the manifest under SerializeRoot, not the config predicates
PackageUnzip replaces SerializeRoot/<mode>/; limits on size and entries; rejected zips change nothing
Strict mode escalates warnings to a 400 naming the entry; false positives listed
Identity is GUID-based (PageUniqueId, ParagraphUniqueId); numeric ids diverge
SqlTable rows match by primary key or a resolved match key; nameColumn only names the file
Three buckets: Replace, Merge, Not-serialized (GlobalSettings, credentials, per-environment fields)
Replace is source-wins; Merge is destination-wins field-level fill
Serialize link sweep fails on orphaned page references
Template asset manifest validated before deserialize
Internal links rewritten by the link resolver on deserialize
Per-run logs under Files/System/Serializer/Log
Merge of a table without a primary key deletes host rows in that table

gaps: No check reads the Serializer run log or SerializerSettings yet: both need handlers beyond the reserved set.
The dry-run checks are commands; whether the ledger runner may issue a Deserialize dry run is a contract decision, so they stay planned.
The admin UI screens of the Serializer (settings, mode trees) are not documented in the DW10 manual; claims come from the skills and the engine docs only.
The engine-floor check needs a confirmed read of the installed package version; the System/AddIns/Installed folder was denied to MCP on a measured host.
